mechanism.canonical_owner: Keep canonical filesystem-v1 logical size + SHA-256 + metadata ownership once in the outer filesystem/profile layer. Current bounded-drift EditPrograms are self-delimiting, so program offset/length and duplicate per-member logical SHA need not be serialized again inside the inner BDC table.
mechanism.integrity: Do not weaken logical SHA verification. The canonical outer owner remains authoritative; physical payload integrity remains authenticated by the containing representation/profile.
mechanism.recovery: Do not assume the research-only duplicated CMPNXBR3 metadata frame is the eventual product recovery boundary. Recovery ownership should be tested at the canonical archive/profile layer.

self_delimiting_microcourt.property: Concatenated current-grammar edit programs were segmented exactly without a stored per-program offset/length table, and derived logical sizes matched targets.

decision: Preserve the currently preregistered coordered court as the control. If it runs green, the next representation oracle should compare canonical-owner/tableless BDC against that control and same-run Zstd-19 rather than wrapping the candidate in duplicated recovery metadata. This is a different ownership frame, not threshold tuning.
kill_or_narrow: Exact current-main tableless parsing cannot reconstruct/select members deterministically from canonical outer metadata.

claim_boundary: Exact-source representation accounting plus local source-faithful scanning evidence. Not a hosted canonical archive, recovery implementation, runtime court, native port or product/release claim.
